_note: K4: utility tables and detectors (src/coach/derive/utility, src/coach/metrics/utility, src/coach/detect/utility; docs/coach/utility.md).

throws._match: A projectile is joined to a detonation of its kind by the same thrower whose tick lies in [first sample, last sample + matchSlackTicks] and whose position is within matchRadius of some path sample; a detonation with the projectile's entity id wins over one without. Entity ids are reused, so the id alone never decides.
throws._he: HE damage: player_hurt with weapon hegrenade by the thrower within heDamageTicks of the detonation.
throws._fire: Fire damage: player_hurt with weapon inferno by the thrower from startburn to expiry + fireEndSlackTicks; with two fires of one thrower burning, the nearer one to the victim. An enemy 'stands in' a fire when within fireRadius (horizontal) and fireHeight (vertical) of the startburn point.
throws._place: Landing place: the place name of the nearest player sample (every placeSampleRows rows) within placeRadius.
throws._near: Fire 'came near': a living enemy within fireNearRadius (horizontal) of the startburn point at some row of its life; a fire with no enemy damage, no enemy inside and none near was thrown where nobody was or came.

flash._blind: Blinds at or above minBlindSec count (Leetify's floor). A blinded enemy 'led to a kill' when the thrower's team kills him within min(duration, killWindowCapSec) of the blind.
flash._detector: Fix 'flashes that blind nobody': at least minFlashes flashes and a share of flashes blinding no enemy at or above noEnemyShare. Fix 'team flashes': at least minTeamFlashFights teammates blinded >= minBlindSec who died or took damage inside the window. Strength: at least minFlashes and enemies blinded per flash >= strengthEnemiesPerFlash.

unused._detector: Deaths with at least minGrenades grenades left in rounds the team lost; a finding needs at least minDeaths of them.

buy._detector: Rifle rounds (primary of kind rifle or sniper) where the player bought no grenade, carried none after the buy, and had at least the cheapest of flashbang and smoke left. A finding needs minRounds.

damage._detector: Fix: at least minFires fires that touched no enemy (no enemy damage and no enemy inside) for their whole life and a share of fires >= wastedFireShare. Strength: at least minGrenades HE and fire grenades and damage per grenade >= strengthDamagePerGrenade.

scoring._confidence: confidence = precision × (1 − exp(−n / nScale)) (src/coach/detect/common.ts), n = the finding's opportunities. Precision is a constant until K11 measures it.
scoring._impact: impact = fights decided against the player per instance, scaled to 24 rounds (K2's scale): a flash that blinds nobody 0.15 of a fight (it still clears or delays now and then), a teammate flashed into his fight half, a death with two grenades left in a lost round a third, a rifle round with no utility a quarter, a wasted fire a quarter.
